text: Holly Vance at Driscoll Mechanical Services logs into the portal, submits a claim, and watches it get routed to the right reviewer automatically.
She checks status two ways: the portal's My Warranty Claims list, or her own integration calling the now-secured API with Driscoll's own partner_company value.
Honest boundary: no automated parts-ordering integration yet -- Driscoll still orders replacement parts through Brindlewood's existing, separate process.
Second boundary: V1 self-service is for partners only -- Brindlewood's own internal reviewers still work through back-end list views.
Up next: writing the real security review report and developer handoff.
